'''??HMTGF??''' is a secret piece of [[furniture]] obtained by placing a [[Super Cucumber]] in the brown box located north of the [[Blacksmith]]'s shop, inside the fenced area. A hole in the fence allowing access to the box is hidden behind a tree on the right-hand side of the enclosure. Once placed, the statue can be moved by holding left-click, or by using a [[Tools|tool]].

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Fixed bug where an entire stack of Super Cucumbers would be consumed when interacting with the brown box.  Added Korean display name to data files.}}
